overview: Expected value E[X] = sum x p(x) (ya integral). Linearity of expectation sabse powerful tool hai. Variance, conditional expectation aur indicator-variable technique yahan aate hain.
whyItMatters: 15 PYQs, 1999-2026; recent saalon me NAT + MCQ.
coreConcept: E[X+Y] = E[X] + E[Y] hamesha (independent hona zaroori nahi). Complex count ko indicator random variables ke sum me todo.
hinglishExplanation: Expected value = long-run average. Agar 'kitne items' ka expected count chahiye to har item ke liye indicator variable I_i banao (1 agar item condition satisfy kare) aur E[sum I_i] = sum P(I_i = 1). 'Kitni baar tak' jaise waiting-time sawal recursion/states se solve karo: E = 1 + sum p * E(next state).
formalDefinition: E[X] = sum x P(X=x); Var(X) = E[X^2] - (E[X])^2.
importantProperties: Linearity: E[aX + bY + c] = aE[X] + bE[Y] + c.
Independent X,Y: E[XY] = E[X]E[Y]; Var(X+Y) = Var X + Var Y.
E[X] sample point ki value hone ki zaroorat nahi (mean value possible outcomes me na ho sakta hai).
Waiting time recursion: E = 1 + sum p_i E_i.
commonPitfalls: E[XY] = E[X]E[Y] bina independence maan lena.
standardTechniques: Direct sum over pmf/integral over pdf.
